_comment: Skills Claude Code reports as available in a session, which are not files in this repo. Captured from a session's own skill listing rather than from disk: the account library lives on one machine and this build runs anywhere. Graded 'loaded' on the map, with the note that already says what that means - real, and with no file of its own to open. Regenerate by asking Claude to re-capture it in a session that can see them.
source: the skills Claude Code listed to the session that wrote this

skills.description: House design rules and a curated visual reference library for building polished marketing and product web pages - heroes, eyebrow labels, stat rows, feature cards, logo walls, FAQ accordions, testimonials, CTA bands and footers. Encodes two hard visual constraints (no outline borders on containers; Material Design typefaces only unless asked) plus the aesthetic language drawn from five reference designs.

Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

Migrate, modernise, refactor, clean up or rebuild an existing multi-page website onto Bootstrap 5 - especially static HTML/CSS/JS sites, brand sites, or e-commerce sites. Covers converting bespoke CSS layouts to the Bootstrap grid, replacing inline handlers with delegated listeners, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and a shared header/footer/component system across many pages.

Public service, civic, council, charity or campaigning websites - UX research, information architecture, user journeys, wireframes, UI design, design tokens, component specs, accessibility annotations, content design and developer handoff. For audiences where accessibility, plain English, inclusion and trust matter more than commercial conversion.
Build a freeform canvas to explore, compare, and iterate on anything.

Apply a rigorous, honest, non-sycophantic working style to any analysis, design, planning, decision, review, writing or problem-solving task. Use when the user wants genuine critique rather than agreement, wants ideas pressure-tested, or wants an honest read on limits and trade-offs.
Humanize content.

Research a topic across multiple sources, compare options, analyse trends or history, understand markets, or review literature - then synthesise it into a comprehensive narrative report. Coordinates research subagents.
Verify every fact, date, figure and legal conclusion against the source documents before asserting it. For the MHR redundancy appeal, Acas conciliation or any tribunal claim arising from it.

Editable docs people share and comment on - the default for any document: a report, proposal, resume, letter, contract, policy, template, essay, handbook, guide or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign.
Create, read, edit or manipulate Word documents (.docx) and Word templates (.dotx) - tables of contents, headings, page numbers, letterheads, tracked changes, comments, find-and-replace, and images.
Create, read, edit or manipulate PowerPoint files (.pptx) and templates (.potx) - slide decks, layouts, speaker notes and comments.
Open, read, edit or create spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, .tsv) - formulas, formatting, charts, and cleaning messy tabular data into proper spreadsheets.
Read or extract text and tables from PDFs, merge, split, rotate, watermark, create, fill forms, encrypt or decrypt, extract images, and OCR scanned PDFs to make them searchable.

Create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in Google Drive - formatting, copying, renaming, suggested edits and tabs, with helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout.
Create new skills, modify and improve existing ones, and measure skill performance - run evals, benchmark with variance analysis, and optimise a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
Make a mod: a change to Claude's own interface or behaviour - a live pane or panel, a band above the prompt, a status line, a toast, a slash command, or a hook on tool calls or prompts.

Set up or manage a self-learning knowledge system in a project - a per-topic memory the assistant reads and applies each session, plus a shared rulebook. Supports solo use and a team's shared knowledge repo.
Create and develop startup hooks for Claude Code on the web - a SessionStart hook to ensure a project can run tests and linters during web sessions.
Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory - conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data.
Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task.
Take screenshots of the user's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling, for doing something in an app on their own computer.
Claude in Chrome - the browser extension that acts in the user's real Chrome with their own sign-ins. Covers site permissions, recordings, console logs and when to stop and ask.
The browser pane inside the Claude desktop app - persistent sign-ins, tabs, reading pages as text, site approvals, and what the pane cannot open.
